question:
How many reptiles are neither mammals nor amphibians?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc973e2411f8ad4fef0bb4a4790325d00bd56ed992922ddab5cf7ef48b59d395.png]
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f61db4dd801493f155a0c63580a4e2ff1f4b05eadf95a4f82d9e2f4ac67a9af.png]
